meta.title: Virex — crypto futures journal
meta.description: Trade journal and stats built on tagging

period.customDateSavedTitle: Custom date saved — click the field to apply it again

auth.loginLede: Crypto futures journal: trades, tagging, and the stats built on it.
auth.registerLede: Create an account — connect exchange keys in settings next.
auth.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Log in

overview.positionTagsNote: Tags stay on the position while it's open and carry over to all its closing trades — partial takes included.

tags.noTagsYet: No tags yet — create them on the Tags page.
tags.deleteTagSubtitle: The tag will be removed from every trade it's on.
tags.emptyNoTags: No tagged trades in this period.
tags.overlapNote: A trade can carry several tags, and it counts in full in every row it appears in. That's why rows overlap, and the Trades and P&L columns don't sum to the period total — each row answers "how does trading with this tag go", not "what share of the result is this tag's".
tags.emptyCombos: No combination of two or more tags yet.
tags.newComboSubtitle: Pick two or more tags — stats are calculated on trades where they all appeared together
tags.editTagSubtitle: {name} · {n} trades · color assigned by the system
tags.deleteComboConsequence1: the tags and trades themselves are unaffected
tags.deleteComboConsequence2: the combination will stop being suggested
tags.deleteComboConsequence3: it can be rebuilt manually later

lab.mutuallyExclusiveNote: The conditions rule each other out. Drop one — each shows how many trades it leaves.
lab.missingContextNote: No context for {missing} of {total} — context filters won't catch them.
lab.missingRangeNote: Entry range isn't computed yet for {n}.
lab.volMedianHint: Median volume for the period: ×{v} of average
lab.rangeHintLow: Entry in the lower third of the timeframe's range (0–33%). Breakdowns land here too.
lab.rangeHintMid: Entry in the middle third of the timeframe's range (33–66%).
lab.rangeHintHigh: Entry in the upper third of the timeframe's range (66–100%). Breakouts land here too.
lab.rangeTfWindow15m: Range of the last 48 fifteen-minute candles (12 hours)
lab.rangeTfWindow30m: Range of the last 48 thirty-minute candles (a day)
lab.rangeTfWindow1h: Range of the last 48 hourly candles (2 days)
lab.rangeTfWindow4h: Range of the last 60 four-hour candles (10 days)
lab.rangeTfWindow1d: Range of the last 60 daily candles (2 months)

tradesTable.emptyBody: Change the period in the rail above — or sync your history with the exchange in settings.
tradesTable.noOrdersHistory: No execution history saved for this trade — resync your trades.
tradesTable.fundingNote: Not included in the trade's P&L.
tradesTable.showOnChartTitle: Show on the chart where the entry landed inside the timeframe's range
tradesTable.entryTimeUnknownNote: Entry time unknown — the snapshot is anchored to the trade's close.
tradesTable.notEnoughHistory: Not enough candle history for this symbol — this trade's context wasn't computed.
tradesTable.contextNotComputed: This trade's context hasn't been computed yet.

rangeCheck.title: Entry range
rangeCheck.noCandlesForPeriod: The exchange didn't return candles for this period
rangeCheck.chartAriaLabel: Candles around the entry, its range bounds, and the entry marker

equityChart.ariaBase: Cumulative P&L: {pnl} USDT over {n, plural, one {# trade} other {# trades}}
equityChart.ariaDrawdowns: ; {count} drawdowns, worst {worst} over {n, plural, one {# trade} other {# trades}}

analytics.noHourlyData: No data yet — the hourly sync hasn't built up history.
analytics.hourTooltip: {hour}:00 — candle move {vol} %, up in {winRate} % of cases (n={samples})
analytics.hottestHourNote: Hottest hour: {hour}:00 UTC — average candle move {vol} %. Bar height is the candle move, not direction.
analytics.longShareAriaLabel: Share of long accounts over time
analytics.weekdayFooterNote: Share of days that closed above open, and the average move, over {days} days. A deviation from 50 % on a sample this size is a hint, not a pattern.

errors.USER_EXISTS: A user with this email already exists
errors.TAG_MERGE_SELF: Can't merge a tag into itself
errors.EXCHANGE_NOT_CONNECTED: No exchange connected. Add API keys on the Settings page.
errors.EXCHANGE_NOT_CONNECTED_NAMED: {exchange} isn't connected. Add API keys on the Settings page.
errors.EXCHANGE_UNSUPPORTED: {exchange} isn't supported by this version of the app
errors.PASSPHRASE_REQUIRED: {label} requires a passphrase along with the key and secret
errors.EXCHANGE_VERIFY_FAILED: Couldn't connect to {label} with these keys. Check them and their permissions.
errors.EXCHANGE_KEY_EXCESS_PERMISSIONS: This key grants more permissions than needed. Virex only reads trade history, so it only accepts read-only keys. Create a new key on {label} without trading or withdrawal permissions and connect that instead.
errors.EXCHANGE_KEYS_UNREADABLE: The saved keys for “{exchange}” can't be read: they were encrypted with a different server key. Reconnect the exchange on the Settings page.

rules.settingsLede: Declare a numerical rule — we'll verify it against your trades.
rules.metricExposurePctHint: How much money is exposed relative to account balance. With leverage it can be many times over 100%.
rules.metricPlannedRiskPctHint: How much you'd lose if your stop triggers. Only calculated for trades with exchange stops set.
rules.metricLeverageHint: Position leverage as reported by the exchange.
rules.metricTradesPerDayHint: Number of closed trades per calendar day.
rules.metricDailyLossPctHint: Daily loss as a percentage of account balance at start of day.
rules.uncheckedWhy: Missing stop or unknown balance at entry
rules.noRulesLede: A rule is what you promised yourself to follow. Declare one, and we'll show how you're doing.
rules.noTradesInPeriod: No trades to check for this period

settings.keysStorageNote: The key and secret are stored encrypted and used only by your account — for balance, positions, orders, and trade sync.
settings.disconnectNote: Trade history and tags stay in Virex. New data will stop coming in.
settings.disconnectConfirmSubtitle: Trade history and tags stay in Virex.
settings.disconnectConsequence3: orders on the exchange stay as they are — you can only cancel them after reconnecting the same keys
settings.passphrasePlaceholder: set when you created the key on {label}
settings.keysEncryptedShort: The key and secret are stored encrypted.
settings.permissionsHintBybit: Read and trade permissions (Contract Trade), no withdrawal permission.
settings.permissionsHintOkx: “Read” and “Trade” permissions, no “Withdraw”. You set the passphrase yourself when creating the key — it can't be recovered afterward.
settings.permissionsHintBitget: “Read-only” and “Trade” permissions for futures, no withdrawal. You set the passphrase yourself when creating the key.
settings.permissionsHintKucoin: A KuCoin Futures key with General and Futures Trading permissions, no withdrawal. You set the passphrase yourself when creating the key.
settings.permissionsHintGate: An APIv4 key with read and trade access to Perpetual Futures, no withdrawal.
settings.permissionsHintBinance: A key with “Enable Futures” permission for reading and trading, no withdrawal. If the key has an IP whitelist, add the server's address to it.
settings.permissionsHintMexc: A key with read and trade access to futures, no withdrawal. MEXC restricts the futures API on some accounts — if the key is rejected, request access from support.
settings.exchangesEmpty: No exchanges — the server returned none.
settings.needsReconnectNotice: The keys are saved, but the server can't read them — they were encrypted with a different master key. Enter them again.
